answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations bind each rate-limited message to a hidden identity. Semaphore proofs conceal that identity while nullifiers expose repeated use; duplicate messaging yields Shamir shares that reconstruct the private key, enabling immediate collateral slashing. Nectar, Quartz, and Jetty follow the same rule: one permitted message per epoch limit, or their bond is forfeited.
